$comment-1: QuantConnect LEAN project config for v1_trend_following.
$comment-2: POST-PIVOT 2026-05-12 (Pivot-PR-A): canonical deploy path is LEAN Local in a Dockerized container on the operator's VPS. The pre-pivot 'QC Cloud' path is RETIRED — QC's /object/get is gated behind the Institutional subscription tier (DP-025), so the QC-Cloud-mediated Phase 1 architecture is no longer feasible.
$comment-3: POST-CEREMONY 2026-05-12: LEAN-side broker swapped from InteractiveBrokersBrokerage → PaperBrokerage. The bare quantconnect/lean:latest image does NOT ship QuantConnect.Brokerages.InteractiveBrokers.dll, so live-mode boot threw `Sequence contains no matching element` from LEAN's Composer broker-factory lookup. PaperBrokerage is LEAN's built-in zero-dependency simulator. The api owns the real IBKR broker contract via services/execution/ibkr_adapter.py — LEAN only generates signals + POSTs them.
$comment-4: DATA-LAYER SUB-PIVOT 2026-05-20: LEAN now reads MARKET DATA from IBKR via the InteractiveBrokersBrokerage `data-queue-handler` + `history-provider` (delayed quotes 1-3s actual lag despite 'delayed' labeling + reqHistoricalData for warmup). The IBKR plugin DLL is baked into the custom lean_local image via NuGet at build time (infrastructure/lean_local/Dockerfile multi-stage). live-mode-brokerage STAYS PaperBrokerage — LEAN does NOT place orders; the api owns the broker contract at clientId=1, LEAN owns the data-queue contract at clientId=10 (distinct clientIds per dev-guide §1.5 LOCKED). Retires the seed-file architecture (seed_lean_data.py + seed_lean_futures_databento.py + universes/* + map_files/* + factor_files/*). See Docs/decisions-log.md 2026-05-20 entry.
$comment-5: Post-pivot deploy: docker compose up -d lean_local. The container's entrypoint resolves sops bundle → env vars LEAN_LOCAL_BEARER_TOKEN + IB_USER_NAME + IB_PASSWORD + IB_ACCOUNT, then deep-merges this template on top of upstream LEAN's config.json and launches LEAN Launcher.
$comment-6: Brokerage: PaperBrokerage (live-mode). LEAN simulates fills locally; the strategy never calls broker-mutating APIs (market_order / limit_order / etc.) — it only emits signals via HTTP POST to the api. The api dispatches approved signals to IBKR via ib-async (services/execution/ibkr_adapter.py) on clientId=1.
$comment-7: Strategy logic in strategies/v1_trend_following/ is broker-agnostic and runs identically under any of these environments.
$comment-algorithm-location: LEAN Local reads this field — the file was renamed from v1_qc_algorithm.py to v1_strategy.py post-pivot (Pivot-PR-A Q3 resolution). The QC Cloud deploy path is retired so the dual-filename pattern from the pre-pivot README is no longer needed.
description: v1_trend_following — Donchian/MA/Hurst/ATR trend strategy on Phase 1 sub-universe (CME micro futures + bond ETFs). Daily resolution, 17:30 ET signal cycle. Runs locally via LEAN Local + PaperBrokerage (for fills) + InteractiveBrokersBrokerage data-queue-handler (for delayed quotes + reqHistoricalData bars from IBKR via ib_gateway on clientId=10).
$comment-parameters: Mirrors strategies/v1_trend_following/parameters.py V1_DEFAULTS. The algorithm reads them via self.get_parameter(...) with V1_DEFAULTS as fallback. Keys are the canonical agent `tighten_parameter` enum names (backend-spec §12.3) — never rename without a parameter_sets migration.
$comment-ib-keys: IBKR data-queue-handler config keys (per QuantConnect.Brokerages.InteractiveBrokers v2.5.17699). The entrypoint deep-merge substitutes ${IB_USER_NAME} / ${IB_PASSWORD} / ${IB_ACCOUNT} from container env vars (sourced from sops `ibkr.paper_username` / `ibkr.paper_password` / `ibkr.paper_account`). ib-host points at the ib_gateway sidecar on the internal Docker network; ib-port is 4002 (paper) — distinct from the api's socat-fronted port 4004 because LEAN talks to IB Gateway's internal API listener directly. ib-client-id=10 reserves a distinct client-id slot from the api (clientId=1) per dev-guide §1.5 LOCKED. ib-enable-delayed-streaming-data=true is the canonical key for delayed-quote mode (verified vs. QuantConnect/Lean Launcher/config.json — defaults to false there; we override to true because the operator's IBKR Pro account is not subscribed to any real-time market-data feeds and the strategy is daily-resolution where 1-3s delay is irrelevant).
$comment-qc-subscription: The QuantConnect.Brokerages.InteractiveBrokers v2.5.17699 NuGet plugin enforces a ValidateSubscription() check at instantiation — calls https://www.quantconnect.com/api/v2/authenticate with these credentials before allowing the data-queue-handler to register. Sourced from sops `quantconnect.user_id` (int) + `.api_token` (64-char string). Without these the plugin shuts down with `Invalid api user id or token, cannot authenticate subscription`. Discovered 2026-05-20 boot-attempt-2 deploy ceremony. See Docs/decisions-log.md.

environments.$comment: LEAN Local environments. The `lean_local` Docker container's entrypoint deep-merges this section on top of the upstream `/Lean/Launcher/bin/Debug/config.json` defaults (Pivot-PR-F). The paper-internal env's handler bindings mirror upstream LEAN's `live-interactive` shape for the data-queue-handler + history-provider (InteractiveBrokersBrokerage) but keep `live-mode-brokerage = PaperBrokerage` (LEAN doesn't place orders; the api owns the broker contract on clientId=1). Production env is selected at runtime via `LEAN_LIVE_MODE`: `false` (default) → backtesting, `true` → paper-internal.

backtesting.$comment: Backtest against QC bundled historical bars. Used in CI golden tests + ad-hoc parameter sweeps. No broker dependency. Inherits backtesting handlers from upstream config.json defaults via the entrypoint deep-merge.

paper-internal.$comment-1: Live-mode operation under LEAN's built-in PaperBrokerage simulator. No real exchange connection from LEAN's order side — the strategy never places orders (the api owns broker contract via services/execution/ibkr_adapter.py on clientId=1). PaperBrokerage satisfies the IBrokerage interface for LEAN's internal subscription + scheduling machinery; portfolio queries return flat positions (LEAN doesn't own positions post-pivot; the api does).
paper-internal.$comment-2: DATA-LAYER SUB-PIVOT 2026-05-20: handler bindings now mirror upstream LEAN's `live-interactive` env for DATA only. `data-queue-handler` = `InteractiveBrokersBrokerage` — LEAN connects to ib_gateway on clientId=10 (distinct from api's clientId=1) to receive delayed-quote ticks via reqMktData. `history-provider` = `[InteractiveBrokersBrokerage]` — the same plugin instance also implements IHistoryProvider so self.history(symbol, count, Resolution.DAILY) calls hit IBKR's reqHistoricalData (free for account holders, returns same-day settlement bar). The pre-2026-05-20 stack was `data-queue-handler = [FakeDataQueue]` + `history-provider = [SubscriptionDataReaderHistoryProvider]` reading on-disk seed files — retired in this pivot.
paper-internal.$comment-3: transaction-handler stays `BacktestingTransactionHandler` because PaperBrokerage simulates fills internally — not BrokerageTransactionHandler (which would route fills through the data-queue-handler's brokerage instance and accidentally place orders at IBKR).
paper-internal.$comment-4: Why live-mode-brokerage stays PaperBrokerage and is NOT the InteractiveBrokersBrokerage: the api owns the IBKR broker contract on clientId=1 with full state machine + fill processing + audit-chain integration. If LEAN ALSO claimed the broker contract, we'd have two competing order-placement paths racing on the same paper account. The clean separation is: api places orders (clientId=1); LEAN reads data (clientId=10); IBKR's TWS allows multiple client-ids per gateway session per the 2026-05-19 probe.
